# Abenzo — Web Development & 3D Digital Experience Agency

> Abenzo is a premium digital agency specializing in high-performance web development, interactive 3D web experiences, Next.js engineering, UI/UX design, e-commerce, and bespoke software solutions. Based in India and serving clients worldwide.

## Core Information
- Website: https://abenzo.co.in
- Headquarters: India (Kerala)
- Global Delivery: India, United States, United Kingdom, UAE, Canada, Australia, Worldwide
- Primary Focus: High-performance Next.js websites, Three.js 3D web experiences, custom web applications
- Primary Contact (WhatsApp): +91 85908 14463 (https://wa.me/918590814463)

## Specialized Services
- Custom Web Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/web-development
  Bespoke business websites engineered with clean semantic code, sub-second response times, mobile responsiveness, and technical SEO foundation.
- 3D Web Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/3d-web-development
  Interactive 3D web applications and immersive browser graphics utilizing Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, and custom shader pipelines.
- Next.js Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/nextjs-development
  Enterprise-ready Next.js solutions leveraging the App Router, server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and Edge API routes for speed and Core Web Vitals optimization.
- React.js Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/react-development
  Dynamic frontend web applications, interactive interfaces, reusable component systems, and client-side performance engineering.
- UI/UX Design & Website Redesign: https://abenzo.co.in/services/ui-ux-design
  Modern design systems, user journey mapping, high-fidelity prototypes, and complete visual redesigns aimed at increasing conversion rates.
- E-Commerce Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/ecommerce-development
  Custom e-commerce architectures, friction-free checkout workflows, secure payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe), and inventory synchronization.
- Shopify Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/shopify-development
  Custom Shopify theme design, Liquid development, store setup, third-party app integrations, and mobile commerce optimization.
- SaaS & Web App Development: https://abenzo.co.in/services/saas-development
  Full-stack web applications, minimum viable products (MVPs), multi-tenant cloud platforms, dashboards, and internal business tools.

## Key Technologies
- Frameworks & Libraries: Next.js, React, Node.js
- 3D & Creative Engineering: Three.js, React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber), Drei (@react-three/drei), WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion
- Styling & Architecture: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Modern Responsive CSS
- Cloud, Storage & APIs: Vercel, Firebase, MongoDB, REST & GraphQL APIs

## Selected Projects & Portfolio
- PetLink (https://petlinkk.vercel.app): AI-powered pet matchmaking, health tracking, and adoption ecosystem built with Next.js, Firebase, MongoDB, and Gemini AI.
- My Coco (https://mycocopet.vercel.app): Immersive 3D interactive web game demonstrating real-time browser physics and 3D graphics built with React Three Fiber, Three.js, and Next.js.
- Full Portfolio: https://abenzo.co.in/work

## Pricing Model & Engagement
- Starter Package: Starting at ₹15,000+ (3–5 pages, responsive design, WhatsApp integration, basic SEO, deployment)
- Business Package: Starting at ₹30,000+ (5–10 pages, custom UI/UX, contact/lead capture, analytics, SEO)
- Professional Package: Starting at ₹50,000+ (Custom UI/UX, advanced animations, database, authentication, API integrations)
- Custom Software / SaaS: Starting at ₹75,000+ (Tailored SaaS, CRM, booking systems, dashboards, automation)
- Note: Final pricing depends strictly on project requirements and scope.
